title: 能耗分析
description: 功率取均值、电能取末值差。功率可相加，电能不可累加。

list.name: workshop
list.label: 车间
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT workshop AS __text, workshop AS __value FROM v_point_dict ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 有功功率（按车间）
panels.description: 各测点有功功率在区间内取均值后按车间汇总。功率是瞬时量，可比相加。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT time_bucket(GREATEST('$__interval'::interval, interval '1 minute'), m.collect_time) AS time,
               d.workshop AS metric, avg(m.value) AS value
        FROM measurement m JOIN v_point_dict d
          ON d.terminal_id = m.terminal_id AND d.point_id = m.point_id
        WHERE $__timeFilter(m.collect_time) AND d.point_code = 'p_total'
          AND m.quality = 0 AND d.workshop IN (${workshop:sqlstring}) AND (SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz))) <= 86400
        GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT time_bucket(GREATEST('$__interval'::interval, interval '1 minute'), x.bucket) AS time,
               d.workshop AS metric, avg(x.avg_value) AS value
        FROM measurement_1m x JOIN v_point_dict d
          ON d.terminal_id = x.terminal_id AND d.point_id = x.point_id
        WHERE $__timeFilter(x.bucket) AND d.point_code = 'p_total'
          AND d.workshop IN (${workshop:sqlstring}) AND (SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz))) > 86400
        GROUP BY 1, 2
) s
ORDER BY time

panels.title: 电能消耗（按车间）
panels.description: 正向有功电能按区间末值减首值后按车间汇总。电能是累计量，求和会放大 N 倍。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT time_bucket(GREATEST('$__interval'::interval, interval '1 hour'), s.b) AS time,
               s.workshop AS metric, sum(s.delta) AS value
        FROM (SELECT m.terminal_id, m.point_id, d.workshop,
                     time_bucket(GREATEST('$__interval'::interval, interval '1 hour'), m.collect_time) AS b,
                     max(m.value) - min(m.value) AS delta
              FROM measurement m JOIN v_point_dict d
                ON d.terminal_id = m.terminal_id AND d.point_id = m.point_id
              WHERE $__timeFilter(m.collect_time) AND d.point_code = 'ep_forward'
                AND m.quality = 0 AND d.workshop IN (${workshop:sqlstring}) AND (SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz))) <= 86400
              GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4) s
        GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT time_bucket(GREATEST('$__interval'::interval, interval '1 hour'), s.b) AS time,
               s.workshop AS metric, sum(s.delta) AS value
        FROM (SELECT x.terminal_id, x.point_id, d.workshop,
                     time_bucket(GREATEST('$__interval'::interval, interval '1 hour'), x.bucket) AS b,
                     max(x.max_value) - min(x.min_value) AS delta
              FROM measurement_1m x JOIN v_point_dict d
                ON d.terminal_id = x.terminal_id AND d.point_id = x.point_id
              WHERE $__timeFilter(x.bucket) AND d.point_code = 'ep_forward'
                AND d.workshop IN (${workshop:sqlstring}) AND (SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz))) > 86400
              GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4) s
        GROUP BY 1, 2
) s
ORDER BY time

SELECT round(sum(v)::numeric, 2) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM (
SELECT s.workshop AS metric, sum(s.delta) AS v
                    FROM (SELECT m.terminal_id, m.point_id, d.workshop,
                                 max(m.value) - min(m.value) AS delta
                          FROM measurement m JOIN v_point_dict d
                            ON d.terminal_id = m.terminal_id AND d.point_id = m.point_id
                          WHERE $__timeFilter(m.collect_time) AND d.point_code = 'ep_forward'
                            AND m.quality = 0 AND d.workshop IN (${workshop:sqlstring}) AND (SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz))) <= 86400
                          GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) s
                    GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT s.workshop AS metric, sum(s.delta) AS v
                 FROM (SELECT x.terminal_id, x.point_id, d.workshop,
                              max(x.max_value) - min(x.min_value) AS delta
                       FROM measurement_1m x JOIN v_point_dict d
                         ON d.terminal_id = x.terminal_id AND d.point_id = x.point_id
                       WHERE $__timeFilter(x.bucket) AND d.point_code = 'ep_forward'
                         AND d.workshop IN (${workshop:sqlstring}) AND (SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz))) > 86400
                       GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) s
                 GROUP BY 1
) s) t

SELECT round(sum(v)::numeric, 2) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM (
SELECT avg(m.value) AS v
                   FROM measurement m JOIN v_point_dict d
                     ON d.terminal_id = m.terminal_id AND d.point_id = m.point_id
                   WHERE $__timeFilter(m.collect_time) AND d.point_code = 'p_total'
                     AND m.quality = 0 AND d.workshop IN (${workshop:sqlstring}) AND (SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz))) <= 86400
UNION ALL
SELECT avg(x.avg_value) AS v
                FROM measurement_1m x JOIN v_point_dict d
                  ON d.terminal_id = x.terminal_id AND d.point_id = x.point_id
                WHERE $__timeFilter(x.bucket) AND d.point_code = 'p_total'
                  AND d.workshop IN (${workshop:sqlstring}) AND (SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz))) > 86400
) s) t

SELECT count(*) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT m.terminal_id, m.point_id
                        FROM measurement m JOIN v_point_dict d
                          ON d.terminal_id = m.terminal_id AND d.point_id = m.point_id
                        WHERE $__timeFilter(m.collect_time) AND d.point_code = 'ep_forward'
                          AND m.quality = 0 AND d.workshop IN (${workshop:sqlstring}) AND (SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz))) <= 86400
                 UNION ALL
                 SELECT DISTINCT x.terminal_id, x.point_id
                        FROM measurement_1m x JOIN v_point_dict d
                          ON d.terminal_id = x.terminal_id AND d.point_id = x.point_id
                        WHERE $__timeFilter(x.bucket) AND d.point_code = 'ep_forward'
                          AND d.workshop IN (${workshop:sqlstring}) AND (SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz))) > 86400) s) t
